target.statement: Standard equal-frequency binning of income produces 9.63% racial bias (max demographic deviation across bins and groups, Equation 2).
target.dataset: HMDA 2023 Snapshot National Loan-Level Dataset, filtered to Chicago MSA (MD 16984), cleaned to 103,481 records

compute.basis: Requires downloading and unzipping the ~4 GB HMDA 2023 national CSV, filtering to Chicago MSA, applying the paper's five cleaning steps, and running pd.qcut plus the bias formula; the paper used PySpark on Colab but the target itself is a small pandas computation, so the main cost is the download and cleaning pipeline.

blockers: Repository may not contain the exact cleaning/config scripts needed to reproduce the 103,481-row frame; the paper describes the steps but the code may be incomplete or outdated.
HMDA 2023 Snapshot is a large national file (~4 GB CSV, ~10M rows); filtering and cleaning on a laptop is feasible but time-consuming.
The paper's reported 9.63% depends on exact cleaning choices (income clipping percentiles, DTI mapping, race handling) that must be matched.
title: Auditing Discriminatory Patterns in Mortgage Lending Through Association Rules and Fair Binning
